title: 并发下载文件
problem_statement_md:
你正在编写一个文件下载器。
为了使下载更快，你决定使用并发特性。每个文件下载将作为一个单独的Goroutine运行。

为了模拟文件下载，**download**()函数需要将文件的大小作为参数，并计算从0到这个数字（包括，即文件大小）的所有整数之后和。

给定的程序输入三个数字作为三个文件的大小，并为每个文件调用`download()`函数作为Goroutine协程。

通过定义`download()`函数来完成程序，并使用管道channel将结果发送到`main()`中。结果应在`main()`中加在一起，并输出。
problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Downloader[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

You are making a file downloader. 
To make the downloads faster, you decide to use concurrency. Each file download will run as a separate Goroutine.

To simulate a file download, the [b]download[/b]() function needs to take the size of the file as an argument and count the sum of all integers from 0 to that number (inclusive).

The given program takes three file sizes as inputs and calls the [b]download[/b]() function as Goroutines for each file. 
Complete the program by declaring the [b]download[/b]() function and sending the result of their operation to [b]main[/b]() using channels. The results should be added together in [b]main[/b]() and output.
[note]You can use channels to get the data from the download() functions and add them together in [b]main[/b]().[/note]
hint_md: 你可以使用管道channel从`download()`函数获得数据，并在**main**()中把它们加在一起。

code_templates.solution_code:
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	ch1 := make(chan int)
	ch2 := make(chan int)
	ch3 := make(chan int)
	var s1, s2, s3 int
	fmt.Scanln(&s1)
	fmt.Scanln(&s2)
	fmt.Scanln(&s3)
	go download(s1, ch1)
	go download(s2, ch2)
	go download(s3, ch3)

	fmt.Println(<-ch1 + <-ch2 + <-ch3)
}
func download(d int, c chan int) {
	var sum int
	for i := 0; i <= d; i++ {
		sum += i
	}
	c <- sum
}
